vb_textbox.text: First of all, I believe the odds kinda change throughout the game, so sometimes even if you choose the better option you might still wind up with a 0 or a low mushroom count.Second of all, this works in reverse. Sometimes, the worse option will actually have a decent payout. However, this was the general path I followed that seemed to yield the best results.Red is definitely better than purple. I got several 0s on purple.Brown is better than yellow. I got a couple 0s off yellow.Orange is better than pink. I did get one 0 off of orange, but I overall had better performance on orange than pink.Blue and green seem to be very even. I could never discern which one was better, if there was a difference. A previous player said blue was better, but my experience in the game didn't really show much of a difference no matter how much I switched between them.Don't be afraid to experiment on your own even with this advice because the advice I got didn't seem to match my experience in the game. There could be more variables in place than it seems. Good luck!
